issues.title: Bootstrap .NET 10 solution and CI skeleton
issues.summary: Create a supported, reproducible Windows build baseline.
tasks: Create solution, global.json, Directory.Packages.props and editorconfig.
Add src/tests/benchmarks/docs folders and Windows build workflow.
Enable warnings-as-errors on owned code and unit-test discovery.
acceptance: Fresh Windows runner restores, builds and runs placeholder unit suite.
No hardcoded secrets; exact SDK and tool versions documented.
issues.verification: Automated tests, review notes and a reproducible local demonstration.

issues.title: Define versioned contracts and synthetic data fixtures
issues.summary: Specify concrete message and plan contracts before implementation.
tasks: Write protobuf envelope, app manifest and ActionPlan JSON schemas.
Define four classification labels and end-to-end provenance fields.
Create three independent synthetic financial data fixtures.
acceptance: JSON examples validate; protobuf compiles from clean checkout.
Fixtures contain no real personal or financial data.
issues.verification: Automated tests, review notes and a reproducible local demonstration.

issues.title: Prototype gRPC/Named Pipes transport and authenticated handshake
issues.summary: Test feasibility of the local broker transport and session binding.
tasks: Implement minimal gRPC/HTTP2 Named Pipe server and client.
Evaluate current-user pipe ACLs and process identity binding.
Benchmark 1 KB request/reply with trace IDs.
acceptance: Transport works across two independent processes.
Document threat boundary and supported Windows build.
issues.verification: Automated tests, review notes and a reproducible local demonstration.

issues.title: Run cross-process docking feasibility spike
issues.summary: Decide if HWND embedding deserves a later optional milestone.
tasks: Test two owned windows under DPI variations, modal dialogs and keyboard focus.
Record crash, teardown and accessibility behavior.
Write go/no-go ADR with top-level arrangement fallback.
acceptance: Spike report and reproducible samples are committed.
No dependency on docking remains for MVP.
issues.verification: Automated tests, review notes and a reproducible local demonstration.

issues.title: Publish threat model, default policy and constraints
issues.summary: Capture trust boundaries before AI integrations.
tasks: Model IPC impersonation, injection, cloud exfiltration and log disclosure.
Define deny-by-default PUBLIC/INTERNAL/RESTRICTED/UNKNOWN policy.
Set consent and capability rules; document residual risks.
acceptance: Threat model includes mitigations and residual limitations.
UNKNOWN always denies cloud in policy unit tests.
issues.verification: Automated tests, review notes and a reproducible local demonstration.

issues.title: Create benchmark and golden workflow harness
issues.summary: Establish reproducible baselines before performance claims.
tasks: Create stopwatch trace harness, fixture corpus and manual task script.
Specify reference PC, p50/p95/p99 measurement protocol.
Add smoke launch scenario to Windows CI.
acceptance: Benchmark methodology and raw schema are documented.
Initial baseline recorded without unsupported performance claims.
issues.verification: Automated tests, review notes and a reproducible local demonstration.

issues.title: Implement allowlisted app registry and process launcher
issues.summary: Broker discovers and launches only authorized demo apps.
tasks: Parse and validate app registry manifest.
Enforce canonical executable paths and fixed argument templates.
Provide launch timeouts and error results.
acceptance: Authorized sample app launches; path traversal/unknown app denied.
No arbitrary path from model input is used.
issues.verification: Automated tests, review notes and a reproducible local demonstration.

issues.title: Implement broker registration and capability handshake
issues.summary: Bind caller sessions to trusted sample app instances.
tasks: Design registration handshake and bounded session TTL.
Verify process identity and map to approved capabilities.
Deny spoofed identity and replayed session tokens.
acceptance: Authenticated sample apps register; negative tests denied.
Every privileged call includes capability authorization.
issues.verification: Automated tests, review notes and a reproducible local demonstration.

issues.title: Build three independent synthetic sample apps
issues.summary: Create visible cross-process context propagation targets.
tasks: Build Watchlist WPF process, Risk WPF process and chart module.
Include typed context handlers with source metadata.
Generate deterministic synthetic holdings and summaries.
acceptance: Each sample app starts independently and renders fixture data.
No actual market data integrations.
issues.verification: Automated tests, review notes and a reproducible local demonstration.

issues.title: Build basic WPF Shell and top-level window arrangement
issues.summary: Provide a usable desktop without reparenting.
tasks: Create command/status toolbar and window registry.
Implement open/focus/side-by-side arrangement for registered windows.
Handle absent/closed window and cancellation.
acceptance: Three windows can be launched and arranged on reference desktop.
Shell remains responsive when child process terminates.
issues.verification: Automated tests, review notes and a reproducible local demonstration.

issues.title: Implement typed context channels and trace propagation
issues.summary: Synchronize synthetic instrument context across apps.
tasks: Implement protobuf context broadcasts on a named default channel.
Preserve message ID, trace ID, source and classification.
Provide cross-process E2E assertion.
acceptance: Selecting an instrument in Watchlist updates two other apps.
Every event has source and correlation metadata.
issues.verification: Automated tests, review notes and a reproducible local demonstration.

issues.title: Implement guarded ActionPlan validator and executor
issues.summary: Do not let model output invoke arbitrary commands.
tasks: Define allowlisted LaunchApp/PublishContext/ArrangeWindows/SummarizeContext actions.
Validate schema, authorization, action count and deadlines.
Implement explicit states, cancellation and structured error handling.
acceptance: Valid plans execute deterministically.
100 documented unsafe plans produce no side effects.
issues.verification: Automated tests, review notes and a reproducible local demonstration.

issues.title: Add command bar and pluggable planning adapter
issues.summary: Connect user command to typed plan without direct tool execution.
tasks: Support deterministic command parser for reference workflow.
Add one optional configured cloud planning adapter for PUBLIC synthetic input.
Make cloud opt-in and validate model outputs before executor.
acceptance: Reference command yields correct ActionPlan via deterministic path.
Cloud mode requires explicit consent and denied payloads never reach provider.
issues.verification: Automated tests, review notes and a reproducible local demonstration.

issues.title: Implement minimal privacy gateway and private local summary
issues.summary: Demonstrate a genuinely private route for restricted synthetic context.
tasks: Implement source-first classification and UNKNOWN fail-closed.
Provide one local inference adapter with configurable model/endpoint.
Block external provider calls for RESTRICTED and UNKNOWN, including retries.
acceptance: Private demo summary can run on documented local-AI hardware.
Network test observes zero cloud AI calls for RESTRICTED/UNKNOWN.
issues.verification: Automated tests, review notes and a reproducible local demonstration.

issues.title: Automate MVP end-to-end workflow and quick-start demo
issues.summary: Publish a complete, repeatable vertical slice.
tasks: Script three-app synthetic workflow including denial test.
Add mock-based Windows CI E2E and an optional local-model manual test.
Write quick start, screenshots and MVP limitations.
acceptance: New checkout reproduces the workflow with tests.
Acceptance screenshots and trace ID demonstrably correspond to same workflow.
issues.verification: Automated tests, review notes and a reproducible local demonstration.

issues.title: Add bounded queues, ordering, backpressure and deduplication
issues.summary: Handle bursts and partial delivery failures explicitly.
tasks: Add per-channel queue bounds and overflow result.
Define ordering guarantees and retry eligibility.
Add cancellation/deadline and deduplication tests.
acceptance: Overload does not cause unbounded memory growth.
Retry does not duplicate documented idempotent actions.
issues.verification: Automated tests, review notes and a reproducible local demonstration.

issues.title: Add heartbeat, fault isolation and controlled restart
issues.summary: Recover from expected child app failures.
tasks: Implement health states and missed-heartbeat rules.
Provide restart action with bounded attempts.
Inject app crashes, hangs and broker disconnects.
acceptance: Shell and Broker survive child crash tests.
UI reports deterministic failure state and safe restart path.
issues.verification: Automated tests, review notes and a reproducible local demonstration.

issues.title: Measure IPC, UI responsiveness and resource limits
issues.summary: Replace aspirational speed claims with evidence.
tasks: Run warmed 1 KB, three-app p50/p95/p99 benchmark.
Record CPU/memory allocations and GC metrics.
Document hardware, variance, instrumentation and regressions.
acceptance: BENCHMARKS.md contains raw reproducible protocol and result.
Any target miss has issue/ADR, not a hidden exception.
issues.verification: Automated tests, review notes and a reproducible local demonstration.

issues.title: Verify offline-mode network isolation and failure behavior
issues.summary: Distinguish private routing from genuine offline operation.
tasks: Add private mode UI and provider health status.
Run with network egress blocked; test missing local runtime.
Check no unauthorized fallback to cloud.
acceptance: Offline-supported commands run with egress disabled.
Uninstalled model yields safe error without unexpected cloud call.
issues.verification: Automated tests, review notes and a reproducible local demonstration.

issues.title: Build minimal tamper-evident local audit chain
issues.summary: Expose accountable, redacted execution outcomes.
tasks: Define structured audit schema and HMAC/hash-chain verification.
Exclude prompt and raw PII, add retention settings.
Document local-admin limitations and rotation semantics.
acceptance: Audit verifier detects a modified historical test entry.
Secret and PII fixtures do not appear in logs.
issues.verification: Automated tests, review notes and a reproducible local demonstration.

issues.title: Document FDC3 3.0 supported-subset matrix
issues.summary: Specify exactly what the project does and does not implement.

List unsupported methods and deviations.
Add schema/version compatibility expectations.
acceptance: Matrix is published and reviewed against official standard.
No blanket FDC3 compliance claim.
issues.verification: Automated tests, review notes and a reproducible local demonstration.

issues.title: Implement supported FDC3 contexts and channels
issues.summary: Extend context interoperability beyond a custom demo contract.
tasks: Create context mappings and validator tests.
Implement selected user/app channel semantics.
Propagate trace ID, timestamp and source metadata.
acceptance: Selected contexts round-trip without unsupported field loss.
Source metadata is preserved across owned apps.
issues.verification: Automated tests, review notes and a reproducible local demonstration.

issues.title: Implement limited intent resolution and app directory
issues.summary: Support bounded standard-intent workflows.
tasks: Add selected raise-intent and resolution flow.
Map app-registry entries to declared App Directory subset.
Ensure existing capability checks apply after resolution.
acceptance: Supported intent resolves to expected registered sample target.
Unknown intent and unapproved target are rejected.
issues.verification: Automated tests, review notes and a reproducible local demonstration.

issues.title: Validate FDC3 subset with contract and external tests
issues.summary: Back interoperability claims with evidence.
tasks: Create standards fixture suites with provenance checks.
Test version mismatch and unsupported behavior.
Attempt independent implementation interop where practicable.
acceptance: Conformance matrix contains pass/fail/unsupported evidence.
No unsupported behavior silently masquerades as supported.
issues.verification: Automated tests, review notes and a reproducible local demonstration.

issues.title: Add optional local entity detection and sensitivity escalation
issues.summary: Improve classification while keeping deterministic rules authoritative.
tasks: Integrate optional local NER/PII detector behind interface.
Create synthetic adversarial entities and false-negative review.
Prove detector can escalate but never downgrade trusted classification.
acceptance: Failure leads to UNKNOWN/RESTRICTED cloud denial.
Publish precision/recall only with labeled dataset and setup.
issues.verification: Automated tests, review notes and a reproducible local demonstration.

issues.title: Implement session-scoped reversible token vault
issues.summary: Enable explicitly authorized sanitization without claiming anonymity.
tasks: Add volatile token mappings scoped to session and TTL.
Reject unknown/unissued placeholders on response.
Add cancellation cleanup and output rehydration guard.
acceptance: No raw sensitive values appear in cloud test doubles.
Expired or foreign tokens cannot be rehydrated.
issues.verification: Automated tests, review notes and a reproducible local demonstration.

issues.title: Implement capability-based model router
issues.summary: Select models based on task, availability, policy and hardware.
tasks: Define provider capability registry and local health probes.
Implement routing with cloud opt-in, fail-closed restrictions and fallback matrix.
Keep exact model IDs in config and document license metadata.
acceptance: Restricted tasks never route to cloud when local unavailable.
Provider swap does not alter executor or broker code.

issues.title: Publish model evaluation suite and cost/latency study
issues.summary: Provide reproducible model-selection evidence.
tasks: Build ≥100 command labeled corpus and score exact plan correctness.
Measure TTFT, end-to-end latency, tokens/sec and model footprint.
Compare deterministic, small local and cloud strategies with equivalent tasks.
acceptance: Report includes hardware, model versions, uncertainty and raw outputs scrubbed.
Selected model policy justified by evidence rather than brand.
issues.verification: Automated tests, review notes and a reproducible local demonstration.

issues.title: Add egress instrumentation and privacy adversarial regression

Exercise errors, retries, unknown classifications and injection fixtures.

acceptance: Zero external AI calls in every RESTRICTED/UNKNOWN test case.
All known egress paths are enumerated and monitored.
